requirement: The system shall refuse a hotel booking when the requested room type has no availability remaining for any night in the stay.
The system shall compute the total hotel price as the sum of nightly rates for the stay, plus local taxes and any selected extras.
The traveller enters origin, destination and travel dates; the system searches available flights and displays them ordered by total price.
The traveller selects a hotel and room type; the system verifies availability, holds the room for ten minutes and shows the price breakdown.
As a traveller, I want to combine a return flight and a hotel stay into a single booking so that I pay and manage everything together.
As a traveller, I want to cancel a flight booking so that a refund is issued according to the fare rules.
The booking system shall apply a change fee when a traveller moves a hotel booking to a later check-in date within seven days of arrival.
Every confirmed flight booking must issue an e-ticket number and store it against the traveller for the duration of the booking.
The booking table shall ensure every reservation stores a valid check-in before check-out, a positive total and a recognised status.

-- hotel booking core table
CREATE TABLE hotel_booking (
    booking_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    traveller_id    VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    hotel_id        VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    room_type       VARCHAR(30)   NOT NULL,
    check_in        DATE          NOT NULL,
    check_out       DATE          NOT NULL,
    total_amount    NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    created_at      TIMESTAMP     NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT booking_dates_order   CHECK (check_out > check_in),
    CONSTRAINT booking_total_positive CHECK (total_amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT booking_status_chk    CHECK (status IN ('HELD','CONFIRMED','CANCELLED','NO_SHOW','COMPLETED'))
);

CREATE INDEX booking_traveller_idx ON hotel_booking (traveller_id, check_in);

-- flight booking table
CREATE TABLE flight_booking (
    booking_id      BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    traveller_id    VARCHAR(40)   NOT NULL,
    flight_number   VARCHAR(10)   NOT NULL,
    depart_date     DATE          NOT NULL,
    cabin           VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    fare_amount     NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    status          VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL
);
-- room inventory table by hotel, type and date
CREATE TABLE room_inventory (
    inventory_id   BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    hotel_id       VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    room_type      VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    stay_date      DATE        NOT NULL,
    rooms_total    INTEGER     NOT NULL,
    rooms_taken    INTEGER     NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT inventory_date_unique UNIQUE (hotel_id, room_type, stay_date),
    CONSTRAINT inventory_taken_range CHECK (rooms_taken BETWEEN 0 AND rooms_total)
);
